message.content: {"question":"Consider n = 0.20 moles of nitrogen (biatomic/diatomic gas) initially at temperature T₁ = 300 K and pressure Pᵢ = 10⁵ Pa. The gas performs a reversible adiabatic compression at the end of which the pressure is P_F = 2Pᵢ. Calculate the volume V_F, the temperature T_F at the end of the compression and the work W done by the gas","options":{"A":"V_F = 3.0 · 10⁻³ m³; T_F = 300 K; W = −254 J","B":"V_F = 3.0 · 10⁻³ m³; T_F = 329 K; W = −254 J","C":"V_F = 3.0 · 10⁻³ m³; T_F = 361 K; W = −254 J","D":"V_F = 3.0 · 10⁻³ m³; T_F = 361 K; W = −154 J"},"correct":"C"}
